component.name: FlClash
component.summary: Graphical client for the ClashMeta and mihomo proxy cores

description.p: In this Flatpak package, FlClash only works as a local proxy: the core listens on 127.0.0.1:7890 (configurable), and you point your browser, command-line tools or system proxy settings at that address yourself. TUN mode and the system proxy toggle do not work inside the sandbox.
This is a community package of FlClash, maintained independently. It repackages the official upstream build unmodified.

FlClash is a graphical client for the ClashMeta and mihomo proxy cores. It manages profiles from subscription URLs and local files, switches proxies and rules, and watches the traffic and connections the core reports.

ul.li: Profiles from subscription URLs and local files, with proxy groups, rules and DNS settings.
Connection and traffic monitoring, plus the core's dashboard on localhost.
clash://, clashmeta:// and flclash:// links open as new profiles.

description.p: The package has network access and shows a tray icon. It has no filesystem grant: profiles, logs and settings stay in the application's private per-app directory, and importing a profile from disk goes through the file chooser portal.
The privileged helper service, which upstream uses to run the core with elevated rights, cannot register a system service on the host and is unavailable in this package.
Updates come through Flatpak; the in-app update notice points at the upstream releases page.
